explain.title: How we calculate
explain.cost: Cost in THB = USD cost of each purchase × exchange rate on the purchase date, added together
explain.value: Value in THB = current USD value × latest exchange rate
explain.avg: Average cost = (price × shares + fees) ÷ total shares · selling does not change the average cost
explain.diff: So THB profit includes currency movements and may differ from your broker app, which may use different rates or methods

dca.title: Dollar-cost averaging (DCA)
dca.desc: Set a monthly amount in THB and a day. On that day we prepare a "pending item" from the closing price. It joins your portfolio only after you confirm.
dca.dayHint: If the market is closed that day, the next trading day is used
dca.required: Please fill in ticker, amount and day
dca.confirmed: Confirmed and added to your portfolio
